title: Zoning text change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Long Island City
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens, in conjunction with a related zoning map change. The change would help enable an 11-story mixed-use building with about 84 apartments, 21 of them income-restricted. The Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 and its Land Use Committee approved the plan with modifications on September 24, 2026.
